thread.title: Analysts Anticipate Apple Inc. (AAPL) Will Announce Earnings of $2.75 Per Share

author: Trevor Kearing
title: Analysts Anticipate Apple Inc. (AAPL) Will Announce Earnings of $2.75 Per Share
text:
Tweet
Wall Street analysts expect that Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) will report earnings per share of $2.75 for the current fiscal quarter, according to Zacks Investment Research . Eight analysts have provided estimates for Apple’s earnings. The highest EPS estimate is $2.81 and the lowest is $2.70. Apple posted earnings of $2.07 per share in the same quarter last year, which suggests a positive year over year growth rate of 32.9%. The business is expected to issue its next earnings results on Thursday, November 1st.
According to Zacks, analysts expect that Apple will report full-year earnings of $11.68 per share for the current financial year, with EPS estimates ranging from $11.06 to $11.80. For the next financial year, analysts forecast that the business will post earnings of $13.06 per share, with EPS estimates ranging from $11.08 to $14.22. Zacks Investment Research’s earnings per share calculations are a mean average based on a survey of sell-side analysts that that provide coverage for Apple. Get Apple alerts:
Apple (NASDAQ:AAPL) last announced its quarterly earnings results on Tuesday, July 31st. The iPhone maker reported $2.34 EPS for the quarter, topping analysts’ consensus estimates of $2.18 by $0.16. The company had revenue of $53.27 billion during the quarter, compared to analyst estimates of $52.43 billion. Apple had a return on equity of 43.50% and a net margin of 21.98%. The firm’s revenue was up 17.3% on a year-over-year basis. During the same quarter last year, the firm posted $1.67 earnings per share. Several equities research analysts recently commented on the company. BidaskClub upgraded Apple from a “buy” rating to a “strong-buy” rating in a report on Friday, August 31st. Macquarie set a $214.00 price objective on Apple and gave the stock a “buy” rating in a report on Monday, August 27th. Atlantic Securities reiterated a “neutral” rating and issued a $205.00 price objective on shares of Apple in a report on Wednesday, August 1st. HSBC set a $205.00 price objective on Apple and gave the stock a “buy” rating in a report on Thursday, August 30th. Finally, Morgan Stanley reiterated a “buy” rating and issued a $245.00 price objective (up from $232.00) on shares of Apple in a report on Wednesday. Two equities research analysts have rated the stock with a sell rating, fifteen have assigned a hold rating, thirty-one have given a buy rating and one has issued a strong buy rating to the company. Apple currently has an average rating of “Buy” and a consensus price target of $224.16.
NASDAQ AAPL traded down $1.56 during trading hours on Friday, hitting $226.80. The company’s stock had a trading volume of 1,350,510 shares, compared to its average volume of 26,826,526. Apple has a 12 month low of $149.16 and a 12 month high of $229.18. The company has a market capitalization of $1,118.83 billion, a price-to-earnings ratio of 24.66, a PEG ratio of 1.77 and a beta of 1.32. The company has a debt-to-equity ratio of 0.84, a quick ratio of 1.24 and a current ratio of 1.31.
The business also recently disclosed a quarterly dividend, which was paid on Thursday, August 16th. Investors of record on Monday, August 13th were paid a dividend of $0.73 per share. The ex-dividend date was Friday, August 10th. This represents a $2.92 dividend on an annualized basis and a dividend yield of 1.29%. Apple’s dividend payout ratio (DPR) is presently 31.70%.
In related news, CEO Timothy D. Cook sold 265,160 shares of the business’s stock in a transaction that occurred on Monday, August 27th. The stock was sold at an average price of $217.79, for a total value of $57,749,196.40. The transaction was disclosed in a legal filing with the SEC, which is available through this link . Also, insider Johny Srouji sold 14,140 shares of the business’s stock in a transaction that occurred on Friday, August 17th. The stock was sold at an average price of $214.98, for a total value of $3,039,817.20. Following the completion of the transaction, the insider now directly owns 68,302 shares in the company, valued at $14,683,563.96. The disclosure for this sale can be found here . Over the last quarter, insiders have sold 400,621 shares of company stock valued at $85,281,642. 0.06% of the stock is currently owned by corporate insiders.
A number of hedge funds and other institutional investors have recently bought and sold shares of AAPL. Outfitter Advisors LTD. now owns 15,838 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock valued at $2,680,000 after purchasing an additional 480 shares during the last quarter. Arlington Partners LLC bought a new position in shares of Apple during the 4th quarter valued at approximately $2,024,000. Paragon Wealth Strategies LLC bought a new position in shares of Apple during the 4th quarter valued at approximately $222,000. BTIM Corp. increased its position in shares of Apple by 1.5% during the 4th quarter. BTIM Corp. now owns 1,028,479 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock valued at $174,050,000 after purchasing an additional 15,481 shares during the last quarter. Finally, Morse Asset Management Inc increased its position in shares of Apple by 38.9% during the 4th quarter. Morse Asset Management Inc now owns 28,343 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock valued at $4,796,000 after purchasing an additional 7,945 shares during the last quarter. 58.62% of the stock is currently owned by institutional investors.
Apple Company Profile
Apple Inc designs, manufactures, and markets mobile communication and media devices, and personal computers to consumers, and small and mid-sized businesses; and education, enterprise, and government customers worldwide. The company also sells related software, services, accessories, networking solutions, and third-party digital content and applications.
